reply_text:
Tobias's message was a reminder to the channel, not a question, so I posted a short reply in its thread in #central-team. I said expense reports are due this Friday, 16 October, and offered to put a reminder on Tobias's calendar for Thursday afternoon. I didn't create the calendar event because they haven't asked for it yet.

I found nothing in GBrain about this expense deadline. The 16 October date comes from working out which Friday follows today (Wednesday, 14 October).
